mentions.name: Compiling with Continuations
mentions.description: A study effort working through the book "Compiling with Continuations" by Andrew W. Appel, which covers compiling via continuation-passing style (CPS). The reader has just started the book with the goal of learning whether CPS-compiled code produces good stack traces.
mentions.problem: Uncertainty about whether CPS-compiled code produces good stack traces.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I just started Compiling with Continuations by Andrew W. Appel.

I hope that by the end of the book I don't find out that CPS compiled code produces bad stack traces.
